$comment: Bundle budgets in KB gzip. See frontend/vite-plugins/bundle-budget.js.
ceilingKb  what the build must not exceed. Enforced — the build fails.
Set from measurement, so regression is impossible from today.
targetKb   the Gate-1 budget from TARGET-REPOSITORY-STRUCTURE.md §4.3.
Reported as a gap on every build.
A ceiling may only ever be LOWERED. Raising one is a decision that needs a
reason in the commit message, not a quiet edit.
Baseline measured 2026-08-09 on the pre-migration bundle:
initial load  335.4 KB gzip against a 150 KB target — 2.2x over.
The gap closes by subtraction, not optimisation. APP-JSX-MIGRATION Step 0
deletes ~1,900 lines of fabricated surfaces (9 destinations with no backend)
before any decomposition begins; Steps 1-2 move the rest behind routes.

index.why: consumer initial load — shell, router, home, ask. The number a user on a 2 GB Android over 3G actually waits for.

antd.why: admin-only, lazy. Must never enter a consumer route — asserted separately, not by size

tesseract.why: KYC OCR, lazy, loaded only on the document-capture surface

AdminPanel.why: lazy; moves to its own build entry at APP-JSX-MIGRATION Step 10
